verdict.rationale: Chroma publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.trychroma.com/openapi.json (probe-confirmed). Its docs cover the core API surface: querying collections by text, `.get`/`.query` with metadata and `where_document` filtering, and full-text and regex operators. An llms.txt, an official CLI and an official MCP server make the API directly drivable by agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and evidenced API reference details such as auth and error handling.
